scripts.setup: npm run build -w @cebo/shared && npm run db:migrate
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n api,web "npm run dev -w @cebo/api" "npm run dev -w @cebo/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @cebo/shared && npm run build -w @cebo/api && npm run build -w @cebo/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @cebo/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @cebo/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
